decision.summary: A multi-axis coherent offset begins abruptly around index 488: U drops ~19 MAD, N and E rise ~7 MAD each, sustained through index 492. No definitive return is observed within allowed context [450,527]; post-492 behavior shows partial recovery in N/E but U remains depressed, making the interval temporary but unconfirmed due to missing return evidence.

intervals.observation: U drops sharply ~18–20 MAD (centered) from index ~488 to 489, sustained through 492; N and E rise modestly (~6–7 MAD) over same interval, with coherent multi-axis offset. Return not observed within allowed context (ends at 527); post-492 U remains low, N/E show partial recovery but no clear reversal to pre-offset level by 527.
